overview: A modern fintech-style Subscription Optimizer app for Indian users to track, manage, and optimize recurring subscriptions. Features dashboard with total spend and savings highlights, subscription management, visual insights with spending charts, and smart optimization suggestions — all in a clean indigo/green light theme.
features: Dashboard with total monthly spend (₹) and savings potential
Upcoming renewals alert card with days remaining
Subscription list with logos, prices, billing cycles, and category tags
Add Subscription screen with popular templates (Netflix, Spotify, Hotstar, etc.)
Insights screen with spending breakdown charts and optimization suggestions
Subscription detail view with edit and cancel options
Onboarding screens with friendly savings messaging
Light fintech theme: indigo/blue accents, green savings highlights, soft shadows, rounded cards
